name: Angra Nest
tagline: Dione's chrysalis cracks open, and the winged monster Angra takes flight.
summary: Angra Nest is the final story chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 2. Having lured and wounded the Siege-type zombie Dione, Team Alpha tracks it to an abandoned facility where it has entered a chrysalis stage under Z-Virus infection. When their weapons cannot crack the cocoon they bring the whole structure down - but Dione emerges unharmed in its final evolved form, Angra, the first boss in the series able to fly.
story: The briefing on the wiki has the LS Captain report that the monster's hiding place has been located: Dione, transforming because of the Z-VIRUS infection, is in a chrysalis stage and must be eliminated before it emerges. Team Alpha finds Dione in a cocoon inside an abandoned facility. When their firepower fails to penetrate it, they choose to destroy the entire structure. Dione nevertheless emerges unharmed as Angra - its final evolutionary form with newly developed wings. The wiki notes that, unlike Dr. Rex, Angra's evolution inspired fear and pity in the crew who watched its survival instincts.
objectives: Round 1: fight through the facility to the cocoon (first Zombie Scenario map with checkpoint respawns and a round time limit with a designated end zone).
Round 2: defeat Angra, which flies, uses poison attacks and deals far more damage than Dione.
Escape sequences during the timed segments must be executed quickly.
bosses: Angra (evolved form of Siege Type Dione)
rewards: Honor mission [Last Soldier]: defeat Angra 100 times (minimum 4 players; excludes Easy difficulty)
trivia: Introduces three new zombie types: Hound Zombie (small infected dogs, hard to target), Sting Finger (extended attack range) and Venom Guard (explodes on death, injuring and knocking back players).
First map with checkpoint respawn mechanics and the first with round time limits ending in a designated zone.
Angra is the first boss in the series with flight capability.
A known bug allowed rapid round completion after breaking the initial barrier.

Wiki tips: machine guns for round 1, prioritise attack-power upgrades unless using SKULL or BALROG weapons, keep distance from Venom Guards, aim low at Hound Zombies, use AT4-CS or Thunderbolt against Angra's large health pool.
